What is MeowTrail?

MeowTrail is a cat-themed logic puzzle by Oakever Games. Based on the classic Akari (Light Up) puzzle created by Nikoli, you place light bulbs on a grid to illuminate all white cells while following numbered clues and avoiding bulb conflicts.

Available free on Google Play and App Store.

How to Play

  1. Place bulbs on white cells by tapping
  2. Each bulb illuminates its row and column until blocked by a black cell
  3. Numbered black cells show how many adjacent bulbs they need
  4. No two bulbs can see each other (same row/column with no black cell between)
  5. All white cells must be illuminated to win
